author: xMasked
body:
• IGN: xMasked
  • Punisher: WQMBAT
  • Reason: Combatlog (1)
  • Why do i want to be unbanned : I did not combat log in a fight, i simply hubbed so i could play else where, i was not in a combat situation when i /hubbbed.  http://prntscr.com/bvxl0z i see that it is against the rules, although i did not leave my team in so that they would leave. In fact, the reason why i left was because i saw that it was going to be a long game, and i was not able to participate in it the whole time.
Thank you for reading my appeal.


I am re-appealing i wasn't even in your game, i only saw you once and that was while you were in my team and it was capture the wool,
You don't have proof either and i know i saw that the DTM match i was in was going to last a long time i left. 
Don't you need video evidence or at least a screenshot to report/punish?
